scripts.ash:questions: wrangler d1 execute studio26-db --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, country, substr(ip_hash, 1, 8) AS visitor, lang, source, page, matched_id, question FROM ash_questions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50;"
scripts.ash:enquiries: wrangler d1 execute studio26-db --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, name, email, company, need, source, message FROM enquiries ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20;"
scripts.site:stats: wrangler d1 execute studio26-db --remote --command "SELECT event, target, country, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_hash) AS unique_visitors FROM site_events GROUP BY event, target, country ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 40;"
scripts.site:clicks: wrangler d1 execute studio26-db --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, country, substr(ip_hash, 1, 8) AS visitor, page, event, target FROM site_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50;"
